brand_oneliner: Testlify — a talent assessment and interviewing platform that gives recruiters and hiring teams (from SMBs to enterprises) a library of 3,500+ ready-made skills tests, live coding tests, conversational AI interviews, and anti-cheating proctoring to evaluate candidates on real-world skills instead of resumes.
niche_definition: Talent assessment and skills-based hiring — pre-employment skills testing (cognitive, role-specific, coding, blue-collar, simulation), structured and AI-driven interviewing, anti-cheating and proctoring, bias reduction and fair evaluation, talent reviews and internal mobility, and assessment-tool selection and comparison for HR, recruiters, and TA teams; not adjacent HR fields like payroll, benefits, or general employee management.
